name: repo-brief
description: Gathers the repo's state at session start (branch, ahead/behind, uncommitted work, recent commits, open PRs with CI, focus-label issues, stale branches) with no model calls, shows it in a band above the prompt and hands Claude the same summary in its first message.

focusLabels.title: Focus labels
focusLabels.description: Comma-separated issue labels to list by name (case-insensitive); other open issues are only counted.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh at most every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: After a turn completes or the conversation is compacted, the band is re-gathered when it is older than this.

briefClaude.title: Brief Claude at the start
briefClaude.description: Add the repo summary to the context of the conversation's first message, so Claude starts caught up. Off: only the band shows it.
